title: P02 T11 fail-closed source security/privacy and PR merge-gate preparation

Exact-head new verifier must pass. Public Chrome Wiki DOM and 16 option IDs/pinned source links passed on run 45309235364. Added live Microsoft-signed Narrator speech clipboard verification and first-observed metadata timing breakdown, plus corrected obsolete Help publication contract after real hosted browser proof. Real Narrator Preferences speech verified in exact artifact #14884851560; palette focus failed next. Actual second failed receipt #14884889067 verified real CapsLock Preferences speech; corrected successful modifier reuse, fresh root, named toolbar click and isolated pinned diagnostic artifact; fail closed against mixed-source acceptance.
